_doc: Nix. ref_cmd.dyn: `import path` of a computed path may load any file. path_sub.include: only a relative path literal names a file of ours (a path that does not start with ./ or ../ is dropped), a directory is its default.nix, a file with an extension is itself. path_roots: the attribute functions of flake.nix (outputs), shell.nix, release.nix, configuration.nix and hardware-configuration.nix are called by nix and NixOS (hard); a default.nix is an entry file (langs.json entry_re) but its functions are used by name like any library.
